description: Animates one source image (optionally a midpoint and an ending frame as the 2nd and 3rd references) while keeping its subject and composition, through native ref2va conditioning. Faces tend to hold better in some cases; camera behavior is less predictable (trained without camera labels). Every prompt starts 'live_wallpaper: Animate <Picture 1> with', describes the camera (locked-off if none is wanted) and ends 'while preserving the original subject and composition.'. diffusion_model. key format, r32; the card calls these research models
use_when: Bringing a still image to life with gentle motion and effects while keeping it recognisably the same picture
